rca_of_the_issue: VERIFIED FIXED. Iter_83 RCA: EmissionEntryForm.js:~2496 passed buildDecisionContext / extractInputsForCalcEngine as property shorthand to useEmissionSubmit ctx — but those identifiers were module-level exports on categoryRegistry modules, not local to EmissionEntryForm. JavaScript ReferenceError at object-literal construction crashed the component render boundary. Fix applied: removed both identifiers from BOTH the ctx shorthand in EmissionEntryForm.js AND the ctx destructure in useEmissionSubmit.js. Inside the hook, those functions are accessed via dispatchActiveModule.buildDecisionContext(...) and yearlyMod.extractInputsForCalcEngine(...) (lines 339-340, 588-589) — not via ctx — so removal is byte-identical-behaviour. Iter_84 confirms: zero pageerrors, dialog opens, Step1->2->3 transitions all clean.
